set.body:
Outcome

Use the same measurement and result architecture as the predictive slice.

Acceptance

- Region, searchlight, and global identity measurements share one execution route.
- Fixed leg order and support identity survive into each RDM or scalar result.
- Per-measurement failures remain typed and total.
- Spatial scattering uses rendition metadata without recreating FeatureSetPlan.
set.title: P4B.6: execute relational estimands across MeasurementFrame and render results
